_doc: What an RMB or E press does during another ability's wind-up or recovery (CastQueue, scripts/arch/cast_queue.gd; docs/heroes/cast_queue.md). Per hero: the move that owns the body (ArchKit.move_slot: 'rmb', 'e' or 'x') -> the slot pressed in it -> {mode, source}. 'queue' (the shared rule, and a missing row): the press is held and goes the step the move ends (a stun that ends it keeps the press DashFlow's BUFFER_S past it). The exceptions: 'fire' (it goes at once, the move runs on) and 'drop' (refused with the deny cue). A recast of the pressed slot (e_recastable) is the kit's own and always passes. 'note' says why a hero has no rows.

rmb.source: Not shown: the data (briefs/supervive-data/supervive_kits.md:51) is silent and the footage casts the Railgun braced and still for 0.6 s (briefs/hero-ref/venator.md) with no grenade inside it. Shared rule: the Burr Charge goes as the shot leaves.

e.source: Not in the data or footage. Owner 113.5: in the Slam's wind-up both go, the hook flies at the cursor and the Slam strikes the way it was started; a Lunge or Meteor Drop throws it the same way.

rmb.source: Data: Scorching Spin is the RMB 'DURING Feysteel Chain pull' (briefs/supervive-data/supervive_kits.md:23); footage 0333-0336 spins on arrival (briefs/hero-ref/juggernaut.md:82-84). The Cinder Spin goes at once, the pull runs on.

Not shown: the data says 'become Invulnerable, then strike back' (supervive_kits.md:28) and the footage keeps him planted through the guard (juggernaut.md:205), no press inside it. Shared rule: the Smash goes as the cleave lands (was: refused).

e.source: As RMB; a chain already hooked is E's recast and pulls him in at once with the guard up (owner 113.7). Shared rule for a fresh throw: it goes as the cleave lands (was: refused).

archer.note: No wind-up or recovery holds her: the Heartpiercer is a hold (its rows are DashFlow's hold rows), Rain of Arrows leaves the bow at once (the 0.35 s tell is the zone's) and Starpiercer is a buff on the bow. Every press goes at once, as the data (supervive_kits.md:74-77) reads.

rmb.source: Data silent on casting in Flight of the Firefox (supervive_kits.md:44). Owner item 66: in the flight only E works; RMB is dropped, not buffered (AshwickJet.lock_inputs).

e.source: Data silent (supervive_kits.md:44). Owner item 66: Heat Shield works mid-flight.

rmb.source: Data silent on a press in Singularity (supervive_kits.md:117). Ours holds him in the 1.0 s cast pose (OstraWell.locked). Shared rule: the press goes as the lock opens (was: refused).

e.source: As RMB; a seed already out is E's recast and passes. Shared rule (was: refused).

rmb.source: Data: Thunderstorm launches her up, then a reactivation crashes down (supervive_kits.md:69); silent on other presses. Ours holds her from the crouch to the strike (MageUlt.busy). Shared rule: the press goes as she lands (was: refused).

Data: Chilling Finale makes her Invulnerable, reactivate to end it early (supervive_kits.md:36); silent on other presses. Ours seals her in Rimelock (item 65: only the recast and Shift out). Shared rule: the press goes as the seal breaks (was: refused).

e.source: Data silent on a press in Abyssal Grasp's reach or pull (briefs/supervive-data/supervive_kits.md:57). Ours: the hook's flight and reel (only the barge works while reeling). Shared rule: the Anchor goes as the reel ends (was: refused).

rmb.source: Data silent (supervive_kits.md:57-61). Ours: the Anchor's wind-up and air smash. Shared rule: the hook goes as the slam lands (was: refused).
Data: Slugwave sends two waves (supervive_kits.md:61); silent on other presses. Ours: Brass Broadside's charge and waves. Shared rule (was: refused).

Data: Abyssalbreaker is a fissure, then AoEs (supervive_kits.md:93); silent on other presses. Ours plants him for the wind-up and the eruption's first 0.2 s (BjornUlt.planted). Shared rule: the press goes as he unplants (was: RMB refused, E at once).

e.source: As RMB. Shared rule (was: went at once).

tender.note: Audited: no other ability's wind-up or recovery holds her or refuses a press (the seed aim is RMB's own). Every press goes at once.

dolm.note: Audited: no other ability's wind-up or recovery holds him or refuses a press. Every press goes at once.

thief.note: Audited: no other ability's wind-up or recovery holds her (the bola's whirl is RMB's own, the dagger's 0.12 s spin refuses nothing). Every press goes at once.
